title: Pathogenic BRCA1 DBD variants exhibit altered DNA binding affinities and susceptibility to menadione
authors: Emma Cismas; Esme Lowry; Vereena Salib; Kaitlin Lowran; Colin G. Wu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物层干涉法测量BRCA1 DBD致病突变体对ssDNA/dsDNA/G4的亲和力并关联DNA修复表型，属广义蛋白-DNA互作研究，但方法为湿实验无AI/物理模拟，故评5分。
abstract: Breast Cancer Susceptibility Gene 1 ( BRCA1 ) codes for a DNA repair protein that facilitates the repair of double-stranded DNA breaks (DSBs) in human cells through the homologous recombination (HR) pathway. Mutations of BRCA1 are highly associated with breast cancer; however, many variants remain unclassified with unknown cellular phenotypes. The DNA binding activity of BRCA1 is localized primarily to its central region, which can be divided into two distinct domains: DNA Binding Domain 1 (DBD1; amino acids (aa) 330-554) and 2 (DBD2; aa 894-1057). We previously proposed a model in which DBD1 targets BRCA1 to DSBs for the promotion of DNA end resection, while DBD2 targets BRCA1 to telomeres to function in chromatin remodeling and telomere regulation. In this study, we hypothesized that unknown DBD variants (T374I, K408E, N417S, N909I, M1008I, and R1028H) with similar properties to known disease-causing variants (Q356H, F461L, R496H, D940Y, S1027N, and E1038G) would also be pathogenic. The affinities of each variant for single-stranded DNA (ssDNA), double-stranded DNA (dsDNA), and a G-quadruplex (G4) sequence were measured via biolayer interferometry. The DNA repair phenotypes of each variant were analyzed by overexpression in HEK cells to determine correlation between binding activity and DNA damage response. Altogether, these results provide insight into how missense mutations affect the ability of BRCA1 DBDs to facilitate the DNA damage response.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌易感基因1（BRCA1）编码一种DNA修复蛋白，通过同源重组（HR）途径促进人类细胞中双链DNA断裂（DSBs）的修复。BRCA1的突变与乳腺癌高度相关；然而，许多变异仍未被分类，其细胞表型未知。BRCA1的DNA结合活性主要定位于其中心区域，该区域可分为两个不同的结构域：DNA结合域1（DBD1；氨基酸（aa）330-554）和DNA结合域2（DBD2；aa 894-1057）。我们先前提出一个模型，其中DBD1将BRCA1靶向DSBs以促进DNA末端切除，而DBD2将BRCA1靶向端粒以在染色质重塑和端粒调控中发挥作用。在本研究中，我们假设具有与已知致病性变异（Q356H、F461L、R496H、D940Y、S1027N和E1038G）相似特性的未知DBD变异（T374I、K408E、N417S、N909I、M1008I和R1028H）也具有致病性。通过生物层干涉测量法测量了每种变异对单链DNA（ssDNA）、双链DNA（dsDNA）和G-四链体（G4）序列的亲和力。通过在HEK细胞中过表达分析每种变异的DNA修复表型，以确定结合活性与DNA损伤反应之间的相关性。总体而言，这些结果提供了关于错义突变如何影响BRCA1 DBDs促进DNA损伤反应能力的见解。
